## 2. Core Technical Competencies & Architectural Capabilities

### A. Web Automation Engineering (Playwright & Python)
- **Framework**: Playwright with Python 3.10+, Pytest, and Page Object Model (POM).
- **Execution Engine**: Headless and headed cross-browser test execution across Chromium, Mozilla Firefox, and Apple WebKit.
- **Locator Resilience**: Primary reliance on user-facing semantic locators (`page.get_by_role`, `page.get_by_label`, `page.get_by_test_id`) with strict web-first assertion contracts (`expect(locator).to_be_visible()`, `to_have_text()`).
- **Debugging & Artifacts**: Playwright Trace Viewer (`trace.zip`), full-page screenshot captures on failure, network request HAR archives, and live console log recording.
- **Data-Driven Testing**: Parameterized testing via Pytest fixtures, external JSON/CSV dataset injection, and dynamic test matrix execution.

### B. API Testing & Automation (REST, GraphQL, Postman, Newman)
- **Playwright APIRequestContext**: High-speed headless HTTP automation validating status codes, response headers, schema strictness, and CRUD persistence.
- **Postman & Newman CLI**: Enterprise collection design, pre-request scripts, automated test assertions, environmental variable inheritance, mock servers, and CI runner integration.
- **Contract & Schema Validation**: Pydantic v2 and JSON Schema validation ensuring API backward compatibility and preventing data contract drift.

### C. Performance & Scalability Profiling (Apache JMeter)
- **Load Testing**: Thread group modeling, ramp-up schedules, constant throughput timers, and concurrency stress testing.
- **Metrics Analysis**: Response time percentiles (p90, p95, p99), latency waterfalls, error rates, throughput (TPS), and server resource bottleneck diagnosis.

### D. Manual Testing & STLC Governance
- **Test Case Design Techniques**: Boundary Value Analysis (BVA), Equivalence Partitioning (EP), Decision Table Testing, State Transition Testing, and Error Guessing.
- **Defect Lifecycle Management**: Structured bug reporting via Jira, reproducible steps to reproduce (STR), severity vs. priority matrices, root-cause analysis (RCA), and regression sign-off.
- **Deliverables**: Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM), Master Test Plans (MTP), Defect Status Reports, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) documentation.

## 3. Flagship QA Frameworks & Production Repositories

### 1. SauceDemo Enterprise Automation Testing Framework
- **Repository**: https://github.com/TanzimSQA/saucedemo-playwright-automation
- **Live HTML Interactive Report**: https://tanzimsqa.github.io/saucedemo-playwright-automation/
- **Stack**: Python, Playwright, Pytest, Page Object Model (POM), GitHub Actions.
- **Key Modules**:
  - `LoginPage`: Authentication permutations (valid, locked, invalid, empty).
  - `InventoryPage`: Product catalog, multi-criteria sorting (A-Z, Z-A, low-high, high-low), add-to-cart sync.
  - `CartPage`: Cart item quantity, removal persistence, badge badge updates.
  - `CheckoutPages`: 3-step checkout flow, field validation, dynamic 8% tax calculation, and order dispatch confirmation.
- **CI/CD Automation**: Automated schedule running daily at 10:00 AM BST (04:00 UTC) with artifact publishing.

### 2. Playwright REST API Test Automation Framework
- **Repository**: https://github.com/TanzimSQA/playwright-api-testing-framework
- **Live HTML Interactive Report**: https://tanzimsqa.github.io/playwright-api-testing-framework/
- **Stack**: Python 3.10+, Playwright `APIRequestContext`, Pytest, Pydantic v2, Service Object Model (SOM).
- **Key Modules**:
  - `AuthService`: Token retrieval, session header injection, expired token negative testing.
  - `ProductService`: CRUD verification, pagination checks, limit/skip slicing, payload integrity.
  - `CartService`: Order creation, payload schema validation, mathematical total assertions.
- **Email Reporting**: Automated dispatch of HTML test summary to QA Lead (`tanzimsqa@gmail.com`) upon pipeline execution.

### 3. Bangladesh Railway Web Application Manual Testing Documentation
- **Repository**: https://github.com/TanzimSQA/Manual-Testing-For-BANGLADESH-Railway-Web-Application
- **Asset Scope**: Real-world e-ticketing platform manual testing suite.
- **Documentation Included**: Full RTM, Test Scenarios, Test Cases, Bug Reports, and Verification Proofs for ticket search, passenger seat selection, payment gateway routing, and booking confirmation.
